control.title: Least privilege access to data
control.description: Restrict access to production data and personal data to roles that need it, enforced through role-based access.

implementation_notes: Enforced through our identity provider; access granted by role and reviewed quarterly.
evidence_hint: Role definitions and access lists for production and personal data stores.
acceptance_criteria: Roles or groups grant only what is needed for production and personal data
Access lists for sensitive data stores match those roles

criteria_coverage.criterion: Roles or groups grant only what is needed for production and personal data
Access lists for sensitive data stores match those roles

automation.name: Amazon Web Services
tests: S3 account-level public access block is on

automation.name: Google Cloud
tests: No IAM roles granted to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers
Cloud Storage buckets enforce public access prevention

automation.name: Microsoft Azure
tests: Storage accounts enforce HTTPS/TLS 1.2 and block public blob access

requirements.title: Reasonable security safeguards
requirements.guidance: Protect personal data in your possession or control, including processing by processors, with reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach.

requirements.title: Role-based access changes
requirements.guidance: Authorise, modify and remove access based on roles and least privilege.

requirements.title: Access control over computer resources
requirements.guidance: Apply appropriate measures to control access to computer resources used for processing personal data.

requirements.title: Information access restriction
requirements.guidance: Restrict access to information according to the access control policy.
